name: Pedael
title: Naftali's tribal leader during the land distribution
summary: Pedael, son of Ammihud, was appointed by God to represent the tribe of Naftali in the division of the land of Canaan. He was one of the twelve leaders chosen to allocate the inheritance among the tribes of Israel after the conquest of the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as leader of the tribe of Naftali
keyEvents.description: God commanded Moses to appoint Pedael, son of Ammihud, as leader of the tribe of Naftali to distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Part of the land distribution commission
keyEvents.description: Pedael became part of the group of leaders who, together with the priest Eleazar and Joshua, were to allocate the inheritance in Canaan among the nine and a half tribes.

keyEvents.title: God's command regarding the land distribution
keyEvents.description: The Lord spoke to Moses and gave instructions on how the land of Canaan was to be distributed, appointing named leaders from each tribe, including Pedael from Naftali.

keyEvents.title: Naphtali's Inheritance
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Naphtali, represented by Pedael, received its inheritance in the northern part of Canaan, a fertile area that fulfilled God's promise to the patriarchs.
